title: Principle 3: Directness: go straight ahead
coreMove: Move practice toward the actual performance arena instead of hiding inside comfortable proxies.
sourcePressure: Directness means practicing in the real context of the target skill and increasing transfer by reducing distance from actual use. The source sidecar contains no named people, studies, institutions, places, dates, or artifacts for this chapter, so named source anchors must be omitted rather than invented.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Assuming more preparation is automatically useful even when it never resembles the target performance.

hook: Ch6: learner stares at browser tabs and realizes motivation is not enough
Ch6: broad modern world pressure opener
counterintuition: The obvious move is not the real move
Most people think more effort is enough
This is not about working harder
tryThisNow: Spend one minute thinking about your learning journey
examples: desk plus laptop plus vague course collection
manager in a recurring meeting with no concrete artifact

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.domain: Laura, a sales engineer practicing with real client objections
exampleSpecs.audience: a learner who has been mistaking motion for progress
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the next month produces visible evidence or another private feeling of effort
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Laura replaces framework notes with a live client-objection rehearsal where the buyer can interrupt and change constraints.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a mock client brief clipped to a conference-room lectern

exampleSpecs.domain: Michael, a social-work student rehearsing in the actual interview room

exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a deadline exposes the weakness early enough to adjust
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Michael practices the intake conversation in the actual interview room where silence and chair placement change the task.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: two plastic visitor chairs facing a social-work intake form

skillTargets: move practice closer to the target context
identify comfortable proxies with weak transfer
use scaffolding without letting supports become permanent

tryThisNowSpec: Name the real arena where the skill must work, then replace one proxy exercise with a smaller version of that arena.

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'
